'''Retractable wrist blades''', also called '''wristband blades''' or '''wrist-blades'''<ref name="E">{{WEGCite|story=Elusive (adventure)|book=No Disintegrations (West End Games)}}</ref> were [[Gauntlet/Legends|gauntlet]]-mounted ejectable [[Vibroblade/Legends|vibroblades]].

Wristband blades were multi-centimeter, jagged, ejectable vibroblades housed in a line down the length of a gauntlet. They were most notably used by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] in his [[Mission to Kamino (Separatist Crisis)/Legends|fight with Obi-Wan]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]], in order to stop himself from falling off the landing platform which they were fighting on.

Modified [[Protocol droid/Legends|protocol droids]] used as [[Gladiator droid/Legends|gladiator droids]] onboard [[The Wheel/Legends|the Wheel]] were equipped with wrist blades.<ref name="E" />
